chapters.label: Buenos Aires, 2000
chapters.text: Buenos Aires, 2000. Boca Juniors against River Plate, in the Copa Libertadores. Juan Román Riquelme has the ball on the right wing. Mario Yepes closes in... and Riquelme slips it through his legs!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Riquelme keeps the ball close. Yepes reaches in to take it.

chapters.label: The nutmeg
chapters.text: His legs open, and a touch of the right foot sends it through. Riquelme is away with the ball!

chapters.label: Shield, then slip it
chapters.text: Shield the ball with your body. When a defender gets too close, slip it through their legs!
